description: Na₃Li₂Al(SiO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.91 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.81 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.14 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.76 Å) and two longer (1.78 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.68 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two equivalent Li, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, two equivalent Li, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Li₂Si trigonal bipyramids.
